name: Taskade
desc: Collaboration platform for remote teams to organize projects, tasks and AI agents.

actions.name: taskade-create-task
actions.description: Creates a new task.

actions.name: taskade-complete-task
actions.description: Complete a task in a project.

actions.name: taskade-delete-task
actions.description: Delete an existing task in a project.

actions.name: list_workspaces
actions.description: Lists the Taskade workspaces you belong to.

actions.name: list_folders
actions.description: Lists the folders of a workspace, including its home folder.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: Lists the projects in a workspace or folder, optionally filtered by name.

actions.name: list_recent_projects
actions.description: Lists projects you have access to across all workspaces, most recently viewed first.

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Gets a project by ID or link.

actions.name: create_project
actions.description: Creates a project in a workspace or folder, optionally with tasks written as a Markdown list.

actions.name: create_project_from_template
actions.description: Creates a project from one of your Taskade project templates.

actions.name: list_project_templates
actions.description: Lists the project templates saved in a workspace or folder.

actions.name: copy_project
actions.description: Copies a project, with its tasks, into a workspace or folder.

actions.name: complete_project
actions.description: Marks a project as completed, which archives it.

actions.name: restore_project
actions.description: Restores a completed (archived) project.

actions.name: list_project_members
actions.description: Lists the people who can be assigned to tasks in a project.

actions.name: list_project_fields
actions.description: Lists the custom fields of a project, with select options.

actions.name: get_project_share_link
actions.description: Gets the view and edit share links of a project, if sharing is on.

actions.name: list_tasks
actions.description: Lists the tasks of a project in outline order, one page at a time.

actions.name: find_tasks
actions.description: Finds tasks in a project whose text contains some words.

actions.name: get_task
actions.description: Gets a task with its date, note, assignees and custom field values.

actions.name: create_tasks
actions.description: Adds 1-20 tasks to a project, at the top or bottom, or next to or inside another task.

actions.name: update_task
actions.description: Replaces the text of a task.

actions.name: reopen_task
actions.description: Marks a completed task as not completed.

actions.name: move_task
actions.description: Moves a task before or after another task, or inside it as a subtask.

actions.name: set_task_date
actions.description: Sets or clears the start and end date of a task.

actions.name: set_task_note
actions.description: Sets or clears the note attached to a task.

actions.name: assign_task
actions.description: Assigns project members to a task by their handle.

actions.name: unassign_task
actions.description: Removes one member from a task's assignees.

actions.name: set_task_field_value
actions.description: Sets or clears the value of a custom field on a task.

actions.name: list_agents
actions.description: Lists the AI agents in a workspace or folder.

actions.name: get_agent
actions.description: Gets an AI agent with its commands and their prompts.

actions.name: ask_agent
actions.description: Sends a prompt to a Taskade AI agent and returns its answer. Uses Taskade AI credits.

actions.name: list_agent_conversations
actions.description: Lists the conversations of an AI agent.

actions.name: get_agent_conversation
actions.description: Gets one conversation of an AI agent, with its transcript.

actions.name: generate_agent
actions.description: Creates a new AI agent from a plain-language description. Uses Taskade AI credits.

actions.name: delete_agent
actions.description: Permanently deletes an AI agent.

actions.name: add_agent_knowledge_project
actions.description: Lets an AI agent use a project as knowledge.

actions.name: remove_agent_knowledge_project
actions.description: Stops an AI agent from using a project as knowledge.

actions.name: trigger_automation
actions.description: Starts a Taskade automation that begins with a Webhook trigger, sending a JSON payload.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: task_due
triggers.description: Fires when a task's due date arrives. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.

triggers.name: task_assigned
triggers.description: Fires when tasks are assigned to someone. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.

triggers.name: comment_created
triggers.description: Fires when a comment is added to a task. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.

triggers.name: project_created
triggers.description: Fires when a project is created. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.

triggers.name: project_assigned
triggers.description: Fires when a project is assigned to someone. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.

triggers.name: project_joined
triggers.description: Fires when someone joins a project. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.

guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Taskade automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.
